caption: 3 · R14-1 reproduced end to end — a later shell's --bg runs with the first shell's key, endpoint and env

name: 05-n2-ladder.png

sub: Head gives up at ≈2.6 s in the wait loop although the code models a ~15 s budget; removing only the attempt cap (deadline-only loop) makes every rung succeed.
